items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: There's only a boy I think had one year by the name of Kaganary. I think he had the picture.

ctx.x: It's too bad you didn't save some of those clippings and papers. Sure have had, sure have had. Did you ever save any other photographs, any old photographs? We can make copies of them, like that one of Buddy Petit. You don't know of any other bands of Buddy, pictures of Buddy?

You know, I read it, there's so many, I see the boys over there. There's only a boy I think had one year by the name of Kaganary. I think he had the picture. Daniel 11? Yeah, I think he had the picture of it. Yeah? You know him. Yeah, yeah.
We missed, by the way we never did interview him yet, we ought to interview him pretty soon. Somehow we missed him, somehow we never did get to him.
